rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for angrily scolding or sharply criticising someone.

example.english: They rebuke me in front of everyone for being late.
example.traditional: 佢因為我遲到，當住成班人鬧我。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jan1 wai6 ngo5 ci4 dou3 dong1 zyu6 sing4 baan1 jan4 naau6 ngo5

rows.note: Use this for reproving someone in a more measured or serious way, without necessarily implying an angry outburst.

example.english: The teacher had to rebuke me for not handing in my homework, but did not raise her voice.
example.traditional: 老師責備我冇交功課，但冇大聲鬧我。
example.jyutping: lou5 si1 zaak3 bei6 ngo5 mou5 gaau1 gung1 fo3 daan6 mou5 daai6 seng1 naau6 ngo5

rows.note: Use this for a concrete bout of angry verbal scolding, especially in casual speech.

example.english: The customer gave the boss a rebuke just because he was a little late.
example.traditional: 老闆遲到少少，就畀客人一輪鬧。
example.jyutping: lou5 baan2 ci4 dou3 siu2 siu2 zau6 bei2 haak3 jan4 jat1 leon4 naau6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a harsh reproach or criticism that is not framed as a bout of scolding.

example.english: His rebuke made me seriously reflect.
example.traditional: 佢對我嘅責備，令我認真反省。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 ngo5 ge3 zaak3 bei6 ling6 ngo5 jing6 zan1 faan2 sing2
